'''NQR Season 11''' is the first [[4on4]] QuakeWorld tournament in a while that does not exclusively use [[TB3]] for its map-pool. Upon signup, clans are able to choose whether or not they wished to play in the "Regular map-pool" or in the "Extended map-pool". However, clans that decide to go for the extended map-pool are only allowed to play the additional 4 maps against other clans that also pick the extended map-pool. Clans that decided to play [[TB3]] are thus not obliged to play any [[Kenya]] maps. NQR11 is also the first [[4on4]] league ever to allow QuakeWorld client [[FTE QW|FTE]] and possibly the first to desire the enabling of [[Fallbunny]]. The extended also included [[CMT3]], [[CMT4]], [[MIDCIT]] and [[E2M2TDM]].
